name: mobile-tap-targets-audit
description: The half of the audit the Chrome harness structurally cannot do: real touch emulation (SHOT_TOUCH=1 → pointer:coarse) at true phone viewports (390x844, then 320px). Measures tap targets INCLUDING the invisible ::after hit-area padding, and checks for horizontal overflow. Run with SHOT_TOUCH=1.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-coarse-pointer
steps.eval: (() => { const coarse = window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches; console.log('POINTER coarse=' + coarse); if (!coarse) throw new Error('touch emulation did not take — run with SHOT_TOUCH=1') })()

steps.name: measure-home
steps.eval: (() => { const MIN = 44; const SEL = 'button, a[href], input, select, textarea, summary, [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="switch"], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'; const vis = (el) => { const st = getComputedStyle(el); if (st.display === 'none' || st.visibility === 'hidden' || Number.parseFloat(st.opacity) === 0) return false; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 }; const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(SEL)) { if (!vis(el)) continue; if (el.closest('details:not([open])')) continue; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); let w = r.width, h = r.height; const a = getComputedStyle(el, '::after'); if (a.content !== 'none' && a.position === 'absolute') { const g = (side) => { const v = Number.parseFloat(a[side]); return Number.isFinite(v) && v < 0 ? -v : 0 }; w += g('left') + g('right'); h += g('top') + g('bottom') } if (w < MIN - 0.5 || h < MIN - 0.5) { const label = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.textContent || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 28); out.push(`${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}.${(el.className || '').toString().split(' ')[0]} "${label}" ${Math.round(w)}x${Math.round(h)}`) } } console.log('TAP_HOME ' + out.length + ' :: ' + out.join(' | ')) })()

steps.name: measure-catalog
steps.eval: (() => { const MIN = 44; const root = document.querySelector('.panel.catalog') || document.querySelector('.catalog'); const SEL = 'button, input, summary, [role="button"], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'; const out = []; for (const el of root.querySelectorAll(SEL)) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width === 0) continue; let w = r.width, h = r.height; const a = getComputedStyle(el, '::after'); if (a.content !== 'none' && a.position === 'absolute') { const g = (s2) => { const v = Number.parseFloat(a[s2]); return Number.isFinite(v) && v < 0 ? -v : 0 }; w += g('left') + g('right'); h += g('top') + g('bottom') } if (w < MIN - 0.5 || h < MIN - 0.5) { const label = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.textContent || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 24); out.push(`${el.tagName.toLowerCase()} "${label}" ${Math.round(w)}x${Math.round(h)}`) } } console.log('TAP_CATALOG ' + out.length + ' :: ' + out.join(' | ')) })()

steps.name: measure-pro-panel
steps.eval: (() => { const MIN = 44; const root = document.querySelector('#clearancePanel'); const out = []; for (const el of root.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]')) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width === 0) continue; let w = r.width, h = r.height; const a = getComputedStyle(el, '::after'); if (a.content !== 'none' && a.position === 'absolute') { const g = (s3) => { const v = Number.parseFloat(a[s3]); return Number.isFinite(v) && v < 0 ? -v : 0 }; w += g('left') + g('right'); h += g('top') + g('bottom') } if (w < MIN - 0.5 || h < MIN - 0.5) out.push(`${(el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.textContent || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,24)} ${Math.round(w)}x${Math.round(h)}`) } console.log('TAP_PRO ' + out.length + ' :: ' + out.join(' | ')); const de = document.documentElement; console.log('OVERFLOW_390 scrollW=' + de.scrollWidth + ' clientW=' + de.clientWidth) })()

steps.name: measure-320
steps.eval: (() => { const de = document.documentElement; console.log('OVERFLOW_320 scrollW=' + de.scrollWidth + ' clientW=' + de.clientWidth); const vw = window.innerWidth; const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('*')) { const st = getComputedStyle(el); if (st.display === 'none' || st.visibility === 'hidden') continue; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width === 0) continue; if (r.right > vw + 2 || r.left < -2) { const pr = el.parentElement?.getBoundingClientRect(); if (pr && (pr.right > vw + 2 || pr.left < -2)) continue; if (r.right < -1000 || r.bottom < -1000) continue; out.push(`${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}.${(el.className || '').toString().split(' ')[0]} ${Math.round(r.left)}..${Math.round(r.right)}`) } } console.log('OFFSCREEN_320 ' + out.length + ' :: ' + out.slice(0, 10).join(' | ')) })()
